title: Reading two pages apiece of seven books every night, eh?
html_source:
Stephen steps into the universe of Sandymount Strand and bounds between different thought strands. As Ulysses can be seen as a series of happenings so can Stephen’s thoughts here however there is a pattern.

He tries an experiment (Joyce invents Experimental Philosophy).
He sees two women and explores birth, his birth, all births in the background of grieving for his mother.

He rebounds from this, with a memory of his family, not the close family link of his mother but extended family with quirky aunts and uncles.

Then explores himself, his wishes, ambitions, remembers the thoughts the family had about him.

He spirals into introverted questioning of his part in his world.
